prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Ruthenium (Ru) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds
Outfit: yami-kawaii — a pink-and-black sailor-collar mini dress with heart chokers, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly below, looking up at her; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance; a soft out-of-focus object of the place sits in the near foreground at one edge of the frame.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is tucked into a pocket.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a gold fountain-pen nib with a tiny hard silver-white bead fused to its tip at chest height; it is all she holds.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: one brow raised higher, eyes wide and attentive, lips slightly parted.

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — ruthenium: a hard, brittle silver-white metal of the platinum family, the last of its six sisters to be found, isolated in 1844 at Kazan University from the stubborn residue of Ural platinum ore and named for Ruthenia, the old Latin name of Russia; a little of it makes platinum harder, and with osmium and iridium it forms the tiny hard bead at the tip of a fountain-pen nib that lasts decades of writing; its catalysts swap partners between molecules and join them anew, and its wine-red dyes colour glass that turns sunlight into electricity — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: petite and compact yet curvaceous — full bust and rounded hips on a small frame — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
